title: Materialize scope-bound current-host admission for inference execution providers
decisions: Provider absence is only an explicit probe-environment inventory result; a single runner Python/PATH probe may never claim host-wide provider absence.
Non-default venv, container, application-bundled or isolated provider runtimes are probed only through an explicit runtime descriptor; automatic environment crawling is forbidden.
Provider production admission is scope-bound and requires real current-host execution at the exact recorded runtime version and an explicit immutable admission pin.
Latest observed/reference provider versions are compatibility references only and never become production admission pins automatically.
CPU inference admission never requires an accelerator lease; accelerator inference requires the exact device-bound HRB lease and hardware evidence.
NVIDIA accelerator admission additionally requires an explicit support-matrix receipt; reference-version observation alone is insufficient.
Admission harnesses may probe providers directly only for qualification and never establish an application routing path around the Model Router.
Decision Fabric may advise ordering over the deterministic present-provider set but cannot add providers, grant admission or authorize execution.
No admission run may install providers automatically or download a model from the network.
TensorRT-RTX production admission additionally requires runtime-cache hit/miss/JIT observability consistent with the cache-hardening contract.
